Deactivate L1 data cache automatic invalidate on reset functionality.This bit must not be set during normal operation. It may only be set when debugging an external watchdog reset, and analysis of the contents of L1 is necessary for debug purposes.This bit is only sampled by the processor at reset. Field values (others are reserved):1'b0 - Enable automatic invalidation of L1 data cache on reset1'b1 - Disable automatic invalidation of L1 data cache on reset Reset Source: sys_por_rst_n

Request to clear the external global exclusive monitor.This sends a WFE wake-up event to all cores in the cluster. When set HIGH the global exclusive monitor in the system is requesting the processor EVENT registers to be set HIGH. Reset Source: sys_por_rst_n

The SOC asserts this bit to indicate that no more transactions are being sent to the ACP interface, and that the ACP Interface Should Idle. This is asserted by the SOC as part of the low power mode entry sequence. Reset Source: sys_por_rst_n

External global exclusive monitor clear acknowledge.Set HIGH to acknowledge the receipt of the CLREXMONREQ input (PM_CONFIG0_clear_mon0 is set). Indicates that the processor EVENT registers have been set HIGH. Reset Source: mod_g_rst_n
